name: Google Cloud Translation
tagline: Neural machine translation for app localization and multilingual content.
description: Google Cloud Translation is a neural machine translation API that translates text between languages for apps, websites, and content workflows. It offers Basic (v2) and Advanced (v3) APIs with support for batch translation, glossaries, and custom models. Developers call REST endpoints under translation.googleapis.com using API keys or OAuth/service accounts.

auth.details: API key via query param key= or OAuth2/service account Bearer token; enable Cloud Translation API in Google Cloud Console.

use_cases: translate user-facing strings for app localization
detect language of incoming user text
localize help center articles into multiple languages
translate chat messages in real time
